exposure: Co-administration of oxytocin 3U and normal saline
Co-administration of oxytocin 3U and phenylephrine 50 mug
Co-administration of oxytocin 3U and phenylephrine 75 mug
cohort: The study included 90 parturient undergoing caesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Co-administration of phenylephrine 75 mug with oxytocin 3U significantly reduced the incidence of oxytocin-induced hypotension and rescue vasopressor requirement compared to phenylephrine 50 mug or normal saline during caesarean section under subarachnoid block.
